summary: InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its June 30, 2026 NAV per share of $13.2318, calculated by the Advisor per board-approved guidelines. The filing provides a breakdown of NAV components but does not announce any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or capital return. This is a routine periodic disclosure of net asset value, typical for a non-traded REIT that has terminated its public offering. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics beyond standard NAV reporting are present. No risk-arb angle exists.
